items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: I think Nick Lucas used a guitar with a hole... He paid $325 for his.

ctx.x: My mother had a guitar and she's a girl and never did anything with it, but my brother and I sort of broke it up when we were kids. We used to play it like a cello and rub the little sticks and it was awesome. We finally broke that thing and snapped off of ours too.
I think Nick Lucas used a guitar with a hole, the sound hole in it. Of course he paid way back there when things were cheap. He paid $325 for his.
That's what I hear, some of those old ones.
